title: Collect all validation errors into one checked exception
contract: Validates every required field rather than stopping at the first failure. Absent gives "<field> is required"; null or blank-once-trimmed gives "<field> is blank". Messages sorted by field name and thrown together in one ValidationException (checked). With no errors, returns every form entry trimmed, ordered by key. Null form is empty; null required means nothing required.
notShownInJavadoc: a present null value counts as blank
